summary: Talorys is a self‑hosted personal AI agent built on Cloudflare Workers and Rust that can be accessed via CLI, HTTP API, or a web UI. It follows the same architectural ideas as larger frameworks like LangChain, offering similar prompt and knowledge‑base features. The project targets developers who want a free‑tier, Cloudflare‑based agent without needing an API key. While it installs quickly, it lacks test coverage, has minimal community traction, and provides no measurable performance benefit over established tools.

github.description: Your personal AI agent in your own Cloudflare account. Chat, memory, tasks, notes and scheduled reminders, deployed with one command: npx create-talorys@latest. Free-tier friendly, single-user, no telemetry.
